entities.summary: Rakuten Viki is an American over-the-top media service and video on demand streaming platform owned by Rakuten. The service specializes in Asian television series and films, particularly Korean drama, Chinese, Taiwanese, and Japanese productions, which are distributed globally with community-created subtitles.
